description: This file defines the ReportGeneratorDao class, a data access object responsible for managing report-related entities in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to retrieve, save, delete, and query report data, such as display fields, filter fields, and report groups, supporting report configuration and management functionalities.

classes.name: ReportGeneratorDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for handling report entities, facilitating create, read, update, delete, and complex queries related to reports, display fields, filter fields, groups, and report management processes within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getSelectedDisplayFieldsByReportId
methods.description: Retrieves display fields selected for a specific report by report ID.

methods.name: getSelectedDisplayFieldGroupIdsByReportId
methods.description: Fetches IDs of display field groups associated with a report.

methods.name: getSelectedCompositeDisplayFieldsByReportId
methods.description: Gets composite display fields linked to a report.

methods.name: getSelectedFilterFieldsByReportId
methods.description: Retrieves filter fields associated with a report.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Fetches a report entity by its ID.

methods.name: getSummaryDisplayFieldByReportId
methods.description: Gets summary display fields for a report.

methods.name: saveReport
methods.description: Saves or updates a report along with its associated display groups, fields, and filters within a transaction.

methods.name: saveSelectedFilterField
methods.description: Persists a list of selected filter fields.

methods.name: saveSelectedDisplayField
methods.description: Persists selected display fields for a report.

methods.name: saveSelectedDisplayFieldGroup
methods.description: Persists selected display field groups for a report.

methods.name: getFilterFieldByName
methods.description: Retrieves a filter field entity by its name.

methods.name: searchPimDefinedReports
methods.description: Searches for reports defined within the PIM context based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchPimDefinedReportsPaginator
methods.description: Builds and returns a paginator object for paginated search results of PIM-defined reports.

methods.name: getSearchPimDefinedReportCount
methods.description: Returns the count of PIM-defined reports matching filter criteria.

methods.name: deletePimDefinedReport
methods.description: Deletes reports identified by a list of IDs within the PIM report group.

methods.name: getReportById
methods.description: Retrieves a report by ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingReportIdsForPim
methods.description: Fetches existing report IDs that are part of the PIM report group.

methods.name: getReportGroupByName
methods.description: Retrieves a report group by its name.

methods.name: deleteExistingReportRecordsByReportId
methods.description: Deletes all related display and filter fields linked to a report ID.

methods.name: deleteSelectedDisplayFieldGroups
methods.description: Deletes selected display field groups linked to a report.

methods.name: deleteSelectedDisplayFields
methods.description: Deletes selected display fields linked to a report.

methods.name: deleteSelectedFilterFields
methods.description: Deletes selected filter fields linked to a report.

methods.name: getSelectedDisplayFieldIdsByReportId
methods.description: Returns IDs of display fields associated with a report.

methods.name: getSelectedDisplayFieldIdsByReportGroupId
methods.description: Returns display field IDs filtered by report ID and display group ID.

methods.name: getIncludeType
methods.description: Retrieves the 'include' filter field linked to a report, if any.

methods.name: isIncludeHeader
methods.description: Checks if a specific display field group is marked as header for a report.

methods.name: getDisplayFieldGroupIdList
methods.description: Fetches list of display field group IDs associated with a report.

methods.name: getSkippedSelectedFilterFieldsByReportId
methods.description: Retrieves filter fields that are marked to be skipped based on order.

methods.name: getAllDisplayFieldGroups
methods.description: Returns all display field groups.

methods.name: getAllDisplayFields
methods.description: Returns all display fields with a non-null display group.

methods.name: getAllFilterFields
methods.description: Returns all filter fields belonging to the 'pim' report group, excluding 'include' filters.
